description: Default user experience as standalone bet tracker, 'Be an Organizer' upsell flow, step-down from organizer, Pro upgrade blocked as Coming Soon, and downgrade enforcement on invites.

userStories.title: Block Pro upgrade — Coming Soon on ProUpgradeSheet
userStories.description: As a free-tier bookie, I see the Pro feature list but the upgrade is marked Coming Soon since Pro isn't available yet.
acceptanceCriteria: In ProUpgradeSheet.swift, replace the price line '$49.99 / month' with 'Coming Soon' text in Theme.textSecondary
Remove the NavigationLink to ProCheckoutView
Replace the subscribe CTA button with a non-tappable muted button: text 'Coming Soon' in Theme.textMuted on Theme.elevatedBackground background, full width, same padding as current CTA
Add a note below the button: 'We'll notify you when Booki Pro is available.' in Theme.textMuted, font size 12
Keep the BookiPro logo, feature list card, and optional contextMessage exactly as they are
Keep the dismiss X button in toolbar
ProCheckoutView.swift file remains untouched (just unreachable)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ProUpgradeSheet.swift is in Booki/Views/ProUpgradeSheet.swift. The existing sticky bottom VStack has the NavigationLink + CTA + Terms links. Replace just that bottom section. Keep the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links below the muted button. All existing .sheet presentations of ProUpgradeSheet throughout the app continue working unchanged.

userStories.title: Add downgrade enforcement to create_invite edge function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the create_invite edge function to enforce member limits based on the bookie's tier so downgraded bookies can't invite past the free limit.
acceptanceCriteria: In create_invite/index.ts, after auth validation, count active players for the bookie (where bookie_id matches AND auth_user_id IS NOT NULL)
Read bookie.tier from bookies table
Set limit: 3 for free tier, 50 for pro tier
If active member count >= limit, return 403 with JSON { success: false, error: 'member_limit_reached', limit: <number>, current: <count> }
Archived/removed members (auth_user_id IS NULL) do NOT count toward limit
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: create_invite is in supabase/functions/create_invite/index.ts. Add the check after invite code validation but before the insert. The bookie_id is available from the authenticated user lookup. Use service client to count players.

userStories.title: Add member limit UI on invite sheet and members tab banner
userStories.description: As a free bookie at the 3-member limit, I see a clear message when trying to invite and an informational banner on the Members tab.
acceptanceCriteria: In InviteMemberSheet (or equivalent invite creation UI), check active member count vs tier limit before showing invite form
If at capacity: show blocking message 'You've reached the 3-member limit on the Free plan.' with 'Upgrade to Pro to invite up to 50 members.' and Upgrade CTA that presents ProUpgradeSheet
If at capacity: hide the actual invite creation form
On Members tab (PlayersListView), when at or over capacity on free tier, show inline banner: 'X of 3 members - Upgrade for more'
Banner is tappable and presents ProUpgradeSheet with contextMessage
Banner uses Theme.cardBackground with Theme.warning accent
When under limit or on pro tier, no banner and invite flow works normally
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PlayersListView is in Booki/Views/PlayersListView.swift. The invite sheet is presented from this view. Count active members: bookie_id match AND auth_user_id IS NOT NULL. Edge case: bookie downgrades with 10 members, archives 8 → now at 2/3 → can invite again.

userStories.title: Stop auto-creating bookie record on sign-up
userStories.description: As a developer, I need sign-up to NOT auto-create a bookie record so new users land as standalone trackers.
acceptanceCriteria: In AuthManager, find where bookie record is auto-created after sign-up/login and disable that behavior
New users who sign up without an invite should have userRole == nil after authentication
Add computed property `var isStandaloneUser: Bool` on AuthManager — true when authenticated but no bookie record and no player-bookie link (player.bookie == nil or no player record)
Existing bookie accounts are NOT affected — if a bookie record already exists, it loads normally
Existing player accounts are NOT affected — they continue loading their bookie association
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AuthManager is in Booki/Managers/AuthManager.swift. Look for ensureBookie(), createBookieRecord(), or similar methods that fire during the auth flow. The key is to stop creating a bookie row when the user has no invite and no existing bookie record. isStandaloneUser should check: isAuthenticated && userRole == nil (no bookie, no linked player). Also check if there's a player record with bookie == nil.

userStories.title: Route standalone users to PlayerMainView
userStories.description: As a new user without an invite, I land in the player experience (Games, Search, Track, Account) instead of the bookie dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: In AuthGateView.swift, change the routing so userRole == nil goes to PlayerMainView instead of ContentView
The switch statement should be: .player → PlayerMainView, .bookie → ContentView, nil → PlayerMainView
Remove or skip the onboarding flow trigger for nil role (onboarding is bookie-only)
Standalone users see the player tabs: Games, Search, Track, Account
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AuthGateView.swift line 62-70 has the routing switch. Currently `case .bookie, nil:` goes to ContentView. Split this: `.bookie` → ContentView with onboarding, `nil` → PlayerMainView without onboarding. The .onChange(of: authManager.userRole) at line 84 triggers onboarding for bookie — make sure nil doesn't trigger it.

userStories.title: Handle standalone sync and default credit
userStories.description: As a standalone user, I need events/games to sync and a default $10,000 credit limit so I can place bets.
acceptanceCriteria: SyncService handles standalone users: syncs events/games even when no bookie_id exists
AuthGateView triggers sync for standalone users (userRole == nil) — currently only triggers for bookie and player roles
Standalone users get a virtual/default credit limit of 10000 — either via a self-referencing player record or hardcoded in the client when player.bookie == nil
Account tab credit bar works against the $10,000 default for standalone users
BetSlipSheet allows standalone users to enter wagers normally with full stake/to-win fields
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SyncService.swift sync() likely requires a bookie_id. For standalone users, we still need to sync shared events (bookie_id IS NULL). Check how currentBookieId triggers sync in AuthGateView onChange handlers — standalone users won't have currentBookieId set. The credit limit could be a constant in the Player model or a computed property that returns 10000 when bookie is nil. PlayerMainView needs to work without a player record having a bookie association.

userStories.title: Enforce 25 open bet limit for standalone users
userStories.description: As a standalone user, I'm limited to 25 open bets to prevent runaway activity without an organizer.
acceptanceCriteria: In BetSlipSheet, count open bets (status == .accepted or .pending) for the current user
If standalone user (no bookie) and open bet count >= 25, disable the Place Bet button
Show message: 'You've reached the open pick limit (25). Wait for picks to settle or grade before placing more.'
In submit_bets edge function, add server-side check: if player has no bookie_id (standalone), count open bets and reject if >= 25 with error 'open_bet_limit_reached'
In submit_parlay edge function, same server-side check for standalone users
Linked players (with a bookie) have no open bet limit
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: BetSlipSheet is in Booki/Views/Components/BetSlipSheet.swift. submit_bets is in supabase/functions/submit_bets/index.ts, submit_parlay in supabase/functions/submit_parlay/index.ts. Check for standalone by looking at the player's bookie_id — if NULL, they're standalone. The client-side check prevents unnecessary network calls, server-side check is the real enforcement.

userStories.title: Build BecomeOrganizerView upsell landing page
userStories.description: As a standalone user, I want to see an attractive landing page explaining the benefits of becoming an organizer.
acceptanceCriteria: Create BecomeOrganizerView.swift as a new view in Booki/Views/
Header: 'Ready to run your group?' title with subtitle 'Turn your bet tracking into a full management platform.'

Benefits section with 5 icon rows: person.3.fill/Invite Members, chart.bar.fill/Live Dashboard, dollarsign.circle.fill/Balance Management, gearshape.2.fill/Full Control, bolt.fill/Auto-Pilot — each with a subtitle line
Free tier callout card with highlighted background: 'Start free — no credit card required', 'Free plan includes: 3 members, singles tracking, auto-grading, dashboard'
Primary teal CTA button: 'Get Started' — full width, Theme.accent background, Theme.background text
View uses Theme.background, Theme.cardBackground, standard app styling patterns
CTA button action is a placeholder (prints 'become organizer tapped') — wired in next story
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow existing view patterns: ScrollView with VStack, .cardStyle() for cards, Theme colors throughout. The benefits rows should use HStack with icon (system image, 24pt, Theme.accent) + VStack(alignment: .leading) with title (font semibold) + subtitle (Theme.textSecondary). Free tier callout uses Theme.elevatedBackground or similar highlight. No navigation — this is a destination view pushed from Account.

userStories.title: Wire 'Be an Organizer' in Account menu and create bookie on tap
userStories.description: As a standalone user, I see 'Be an Organizer' in my Account menu and tapping Get Started creates my organizer account.
acceptanceCriteria: In AccountView playerMenuSection, add 'Be an Organizer' NavigationLink row above the 'About' row
Row uses crown.fill icon in Theme.gold color with chevron.right trailing
Row only visible when user is standalone (player.bookie == nil or authManager.isStandaloneUser)
Row is hidden for players linked to a bookie
NavigationLink pushes BecomeOrganizerView
BecomeOrganizerView 'Get Started' button creates a bookie record for the user via AuthManager (reuse existing bookie creation logic)
After bookie creation, userRole switches to .bookie and app routes to ContentView (bookie dashboard)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AccountView is in Booki/Views/AccountView.swift. The playerMenuSection starts around line 513. Add the new row before the About NavigationLink. For bookie creation, AuthManager likely has an ensureBookie() or createBookieRecord() method that was disabled in US-004 — expose it as a callable method. After creation, AuthManager.userRole should become .bookie which triggers AuthGateView re-routing. May need to also trigger sync after bookie creation.

userStories.title: Add step_down_organizer edge function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a server-side function to safely remove the bookie role after validating no members or invites exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/step_down_organizer/index.ts
Validate JWT auth — get user ID from auth header
Look up bookie record for the authenticated user
Count active players with bookie_id matching (auth_user_id IS NOT NULL)
Count open invites for the bookie (unclaimed invite records)
If active members > 0 OR open invites > 0, return 403 with { success: false, error: 'has_members_or_invites', members: <count>, invites: <count> }
If both are 0, delete the bookie record from bookies table
Return 200 with { success: true }
Use shared helpers: cors.ts, supabase.ts for service client
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow the pattern of other edge functions in supabase/functions/. Import getUserIdFromAuthHeader from _shared/supabase.ts. Use the service role client for the delete operation. The bookie's associated data (if any) should be considered — but since we require 0 members and 0 invites, there shouldn't be dependent data. Check for any bets/ledger entries tied to this bookie and decide if they should prevent step-down or be preserved.

userStories.title: Add Step Down as Organizer UI in bookie Settings
userStories.description: As a bookie with no members or invites, I can step down to return to standalone bet tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: In SettingsView, add 'Step Down as Organizer' row in the settings menu (near bottom, before About or Log Out)
Row uses person.crop.circle.badge.minus icon in Theme.danger color, red text
Tapping shows confirmation alert: 'Are you sure? Your organizer dashboard and settings will be removed. Your personal pick history will be preserved.'
On confirm, call step_down_organizer edge function via EdgeFunctionService
On success (200), clear the local bookie record and set userRole to nil — app routes to PlayerMainView
On failure with 'has_members_or_invites' error, show alert: 'You still have active members or open invites. Archive all members and delete invites before stepping down.'
Show loading state during the edge function call
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SettingsView is in Booki/Views/SettingsView.swift. The settings menu has navigable rows (Profile, Balance Alerts, Pick Management, Export Data, About). Add the step-down row as a destructive action near the bottom. EdgeFunctionService is in Booki/Services/EdgeFunctionService.swift — follow the existing invoke() pattern. After successful step-down, AuthManager needs to clear bookie state (currentBookieId = nil, userRole = nil).

userStories.title: Hide standalone-irrelevant UI in Account and player views
userStories.description: As a standalone user, I don't see settlement, balance clearing, or organizer-specific info that doesn't apply to me.
acceptanceCriteria: In AccountView, hide the credit utilization bar when user is standalone (no bookie)
In AccountView profileAndPreferencesCard, show 'Organizer' row as 'None' or hide it entirely for standalone users
In AccountView, hide any settle up / adjust balance actions for standalone users
Performance card still shows: Record, Open Picks, Win Rate, Performance, ROI — these all work for standalone
Activity row still accessible — shows graded picks in history
Standalone Account view is clean and focused on personal bet tracking stats
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AccountView is in Booki/Views/AccountView.swift. The credit bar is in the performanceCard section. Check player.bookie == nil or authManager.isStandaloneUser to determine visibility. The profileAndPreferencesCard has an Organizer row at line ~303. Balance-related actions may be in the menu section or elsewhere. Keep the view functional — just hide what doesn't apply.
